 - > so sab sa phela hum na aik file banai ci.yml
 - > then hum na is file mai workflow likhna start kar diya 
 - > then hum na on define kiya jis mai hum ya batata hain ka ap kis baat par run karana chata ho 
 - > like push , pull request etc
 - > then hum na jobs define kiya jis mai hum ya batata hain ka ap kya kya kaam karana chata ho  
 - > like test , build , deploy etc
 - > like validate , build , test ye sab aik job hain is ka andar hum small action ya task define karta hain
 - > hum na runons likha ta ka hamari vm par aik ubuntu install mila .
 - > then hum na steps define kiya ka sab sa phela cehckout karo then install karo dependencies then run karo test then build then deploy
 - > ⚙️ 3. What happens internally (backend story)
# GitHub creates Ubuntu VM
# checkout brings your code inside VM
# setup-node runs
# It downloads Node.js binary from official source
# Installs it inside VM
# Sets environment PATH
# Now node and npm commands work

# 👉 After this:

# VM can run JavaScript code
# npm install works
# tests can run

Install dependencies (npm install / pip install)
- > is part ka andar jitni bhi external libraired hai woh sab kuch install karni hai jo hamra code ko chalna ka liya kaam ati hain . 
- > express , react etc jitni bhi hain wo install hongi ta ka wo code chal sake
⚙️ 3. What is happening here (simple flow)
VM starts 🖥️
Code is downloaded (checkout)
Node.js is installed (setup-node)
Now this step runs:

👉 npm ci

It will:

read package.json
download all required packages
create node_modules

Add YAML syntax validation (GitHub Actions lint or yamllint)

ab hum yaml file apni check kern ga ka kiya us ki sara spaces wagera sahi hain ya koi aurr masla hai 


---------------------------------------------------------

ab hum code ka andar linting add karen ga menas check karen ga kahen colon ya const , var ka issues tu nahi hain ya phir koi invlaid js code likha ho woh check karti hai ya koi undefiend varable etc so ye sab kaam is ka hai 
If you remove ESLint:
👉 Your JS code can have errors and CI won’t catch them

If you remove yamllint:
👉 Your workflow file can break
